Name: Giant Invisible Crops
Author: EnbyFelix
Description:
Makes it possible for the invisible crops from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/114762643]CopperSun[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9026]Sam and Vincent's Cola Shop[/url] to become giant. Yes, they will still be invisible.

To use this mod:
(You will need Sam and Vincent's Cola Shop installed.)
Unzip the files in this mod into your mod folder. If you did it correctly, there should be giant.pngs in all of four the crops in the JA folder of Sam and Vincent's Cola Shop. (They will be blank, but that is to be expected. They are invisible crops, after all.)


Thank you to CopperSun for letting me make giant crop versions of her crops.

If you want a higher chance of getting giant crops, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/116553368]atravita[/url] made this wonderful mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11620]Giant Crop Fertilizer[/url].
